name: adventurers-tavern
description: 《冒险者酒馆》Adventurer's Tavern —— 东方修仙题材多人在线经营游戏

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tavern/shared && npm run build -w @tavern/database && npm run build -w @tavern/server && npm run build -w @tavern/web && npm run build -w @tavern/admin
scripts.start: npm run build -w @tavern/shared && npm run build -w @tavern/database && npm run build -w @tavern/server && node apps/server/dist/index.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tavern/shared && npm run build -w @tavern/database && npm run typecheck -w @tavern/server && npm run typecheck -w @tavern/web && npm run typecheck -w @tavern/admin
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @tavern/shared && npm run build -w @tavern/database && npm run dev -w @tavern/server
